conditions: Free, but requires a real registered business entity with verifiable legal name, address, phone, and owner/officer — D&B validates the information and may call to verify
Standard processing takes up to 30 business days; an optional paid expedite (≈8 business days) is offered at checkout but not required
requirements: Must be an actual business entity — legal name, business address (separate D-U-N-S per location), phone, owner/president/CEO name, legal structure, founding year, primary industry, employee count
First run the D-U-N-S Number Lookup to check the business isn't already in the database
Applicant picks a track: US-based business, Canada-based business, Apple developer, FDA UFI, or Google Developer
preparation: Legal business name, address, and phone
Founding year, primary industry, total employees
Expect a possible verification call from a D&B representative
workflow: Use the D-U-N-S Number Lookup tool to confirm no existing record
Open https://www.dnb.com/en-us/smb/duns/get-a-duns-form.html and choose the applicable company type
Fill out the business information fields and submit the request
Decline the expedite upsell unless faster turnaround is needed — the number itself is free
Respond to any D&B verification contact; the D-U-N-S Number arrives by email once authenticated
After issuance, use the free D-U-N-S Manager to view/update the company profile
watchFor: dnb.com returns HTTP 403 to automated fetches — form interaction likely needs a real browser/session
Expedite upsell during checkout — explicitly optional ('This is not required')
This is a business-identity registry (citation/credit listing), not a product directory — the outcome is a D&B company profile, not a launch listing
Up to 30 business days for the free path
A solo/fake entity will fail validation — do not submit fabricated businesses
countsAsLive: The business has an assigned D-U-N-S Number and a viewable D&B company profile (verifiable via D-U-N-S Lookup / D-U-N-S Manager)
unknowns: Exact fields and session flow of the form (403-blocked to automation)
